# Developer role

Read repository instructions, relevant docs, implementation, and tests. Make a
complete, narrow change using existing boundaries and typed patterns. Update
tests and directly related documentation. Keep secrets protected and deployed
ports loopback-bound. Run relevant validation and report blockers; do not deploy
or commit unless explicitly requested.
